content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a stark reality: global payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or unreliable. This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a barrier to commerce. If you sell ebooks, courses, or templates, your ability to collect payment is broken by design. Sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] solves this. It’s not a workaround; it’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-4|The Real]]-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-5|architecture]]. No platforms. No subscriptions. No dependency on third-party services. You own the stack. You control the flow. This post breaks down the real architecture behind crypto payment gateways for digital products. Built for creators who need to sell today, without waiting for permission.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned system for selling digital products. It combines free and paid tools into a unified stack. The core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each piece is decoupled, meaning no single point of failure. For example, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend tasks like order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store transaction data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. The result? A system that works even when global platforms reject you. This isn’t about avoiding fees—it’s about owning your commerce pipeline. No platform can shut you down. No currency collapse can stop you. This is infrastructure sovereignty, built for creators who refuse to be locked out.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and stateless. Here’s the flow: A buyer selects a product on your storefront, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend—Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—generates a unique payment link via NOWPayments. The buyer pays in crypto (e.g., USDT on BSC for low fees). NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook. The backend confirms payment, stores the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and triggers file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives their product instantly. No buyer account required. No KYC. No platform fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5%. The system is automated, secure, and self-sustaining. You deploy it once, and it runs without intervention. This is how creators in restricted regions sell digital products today, not tomorrow.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this is for you. It’s for creators who refuse to be dependent on platforms that can reject them at any moment. It’s for creators who need to own their commerce pipeline, not rent it. For example, a graphic designer in Nairobi selling font packs. A music producer in Lagos selling beats. A course creator in Karachi selling video tutorials. These creators need a system that works regardless of their location or currency. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives them that. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Built for creators who choose better architecture, not workarounds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership of your sales pipeline.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, from payment processing to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your digital products instantly. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. The key is how these components integrate. For example, Cloudflare Workers can directly query Supabase for order data, or Google Apps Script can trigger file delivery from Google Drive. The stack is designed for flexibility. You can swap components as needed. For instance, replace Google Sheets with Supabase for more advanced queries. Or use Cloudflare R2 instead of Google Drive for faster file delivery. The system adapts to your needs, not the other way around.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying sovereign commerce infrastructure starts with choosing the right stack. For most creators, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the best starting point. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates. Here’s the process: First, decide which hosting and backend tools fit your needs. Second, set up NOWPayments for crypto payments. Third, configure order storage and file delivery. Fourth, test the entire flow end-to-end. Finally, load your products and go live. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and source code. No technical expertise required. You own the stack the moment it’s deployed. No platform access. No subscriptions. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure, built for creators who refuse to be locked out.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, reliable storefronts. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payments, orders, and file delivery. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets to securely store transaction data. 4. Enable file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant product delivery. 5. Integrate crypto payments: NOWPayments for automatic on-chain verification with a 0.5% fee. 6. Test the flow: Ensure payments trigger file delivery and order storage. 7. Load your products: Add ebooks, courses, or templates to your storefront. 8. Go live: Deploy your stack and start selling. 9. Monitor performance: Track transactions and optimize as needed. 10. Scale: Add more products or upgrade components as your business grows.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and source code. No technical expertise required. You can deploy the stack in 48 hours with minimal effort.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and USDC. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. The stack is self-owned. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% per transaction. No subscriptions. No platform fees.
Can I sell physical products with this?
No. This architecture is designed for digital products only: ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The system is modular. You can replace NOWPayments with another crypto payment gateway. The rest of the stack remains operational.
